title: Final Force Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric force on the charge q.

title: Final Potential Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the potential of the inner surface of the conducting shell.

title: Use of Image Charges
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the method of images to determine the force on the charge.

title: Equipotential Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize that the conducting shell is an equipotential body.

title: Distance and Charge Relations
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the correct relationships between the distances and charges in their calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the expression for the force or potential.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
